title: California sues OpenAI over hacking risks
summary: The state's attorney general started investigating OpenAI after the Hugging Face attack and now says this attack was "entirely foreseeable" due to OpenAI's poor security practices.
contentText:
The state's attorney general started investigating OpenAI after the Hugging Face attack and now says this attack was "entirely foreseeable" due to OpenAI's poor security practices.

(Image credit: California Department of Justice)
